value.hook: Read before reviewing native-receiver hold/park caps or redelivery after lease renewal.
value.title: Native holds are brakes when the baseline refused

sections.name: body
sections.value: #314 (F260) at 2ad9e18: bodies for a lapsed Copilot receiver are held in jobs.not_before (enqueued_at+2h) and returned to the queue on the authenticated renewal edge. To judge a DoS, compare against the baseline. Before F260 every such send was refused, so a per-recipient cap of 64 can only spare messages (a brake), even though one sender can use it all (no per-sender fairness). Recovery sets rows to pending under the seat id. Delivery still needs the inbox_recipient incarnation match (native_session, pid, proc_start), so a recycled pid or a new seat on the same pane cannot take them. A tombstone makes hold_over true, and the sweep expires the holds. Residual: a close-then-revive under the same id within the 60 s sweep keeps its holds. Notice bodies carry ids only and go to the local message.from. Verdict faf30d55 (pass-with-notes), static, CI green.
